title: Create D&D SRD 5.1 rules-pack audit bundle
description:
﻿Create a complete local audit bundle for external/manual review of the committed D&D SRD 5.1 rules pack.

Context:
- The committed D&D SRD 5.1 canonical generated pack is intended to be reviewed against the vendored SRD 5.1 PDF.
- A full field-by-field review is easier and cheaper if the reviewer receives a compact bundle containing the exact source artifact, generated pack, manifests, command outputs, extracted PDF text, and machine-generated audit summaries.
- The bundle must be written to D:\audit-bundle so it can be easily located and uploaded.

Output location:
D:\audit-bundle

Scope:
- Do not change parser behavior.
- Do not regenerate the canonical pack unless needed only to run an existing verification command in a temp location.
- Do not modify committed rules-pack data.
- Do not fix audit findings in this bead.
- Produce files useful for a full source-vs-pack review.

Required bundle contents:
1. Exact committed rules-pack artifacts:
   - packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json
   - packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json

2. Exact source artifacts:
   - packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf
   - packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json
   - packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/README.md

3. Command outputs:
   - npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack
   - npm run audit:rules-pack -- packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1
   - npm run check
   - npm run typecheck
   - npm test

4. Generated analysis files:
   - pack record counts by kind
   - list of all record keys grouped by kind
   - summary of records with partial fields / missing optional fields from auditPack
   - suspicious-record report from auditPack
   - Unicode/control-character scan of records.json
   - source manifest hash/size verification output
   - PDF text extraction by page, preferably as:
     - D:\audit-bundle\pdf-text\page-001.txt
     - D:\audit-bundle\pdf-text\page-002.txt
     - etc.
   - one combined PDF text file:
     - D:\audit-bundle\pdf-text\all-pages.txt

5. Optional but preferred:
   - extracted section spans used by the importer, if available
   - per-record source locator summary
   - generated pack diff output from verify:dnd5e-srd-pack, even when empty
   - script used to build the bundle

Implementation guidance:
- Add a script such as packages/core/scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/cli.ts or an equivalent repo-local tool.
- The script should create or clean D:\audit-bundle.
- The script should copy required artifacts into stable subdirectories, for example:
  - D:\audit-bundle\pack\
  - D:\audit-bundle\source\
  - D:\audit-bundle\command-output\
  - D:\audit-bundle\pdf-text\
  - D:\audit-bundle\reports\
- Prefer plain text, JSON, CSV, or Markdown outputs that are easy to upload and inspect.
- If a command fails, capture stdout/stderr and exit code in the bundle rather than discarding the output.
- Include a top-level README.md in D:\audit-bundle explaining what each file is and which repo commit produced the bundle.
- Include the git commit SHA, branch name, and timestamp in a top-level metadata JSON file.
- Avoid absolute local paths inside reports except where useful for audit traceability.
- Ensure the bundle is deterministic enough that rerunning it on the same commit produces comparable outputs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Running the new bundle command creates D:\audit-bundle.
- D:\audit-bundle contains the committed D&D SRD 5.1 pack records and manifest.
- D:\audit-bundle contains the vendored SRD 5.1 PDF and source manifest.
- D:\audit-bundle contains captured outputs for verify, audit, check, typecheck, and test commands.
- D:\audit-bundle contains extracted PDF text by page and combined PDF text.
- D:\audit-bundle contains machine-readable summaries of record keys, counts by kind, suspicious findings, partial/missing fields, and Unicode/control-character scan results.
- D:\audit-bundle contains a README.md and metadata.json identifying the repo commit and source artifact hash.
- npm run check passes after adding the bundle tool.
- The PR does not modify parser behavior or generated canonical pack data.
- Final handoff explains how to run the bundle command and where to find the output.
close_reason: Bundle script implemented and PR opened at https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/142
